Initial release — Git branch cleanup audit and automation tool.

- Audits all local and remote Git branches, categorizing them as safe-to-delete, stale-unmerged, orphaned, or active.
- Detects merged, stale (inactive and unmerged), and orphaned (local only) branches.
- Optionally cross-references GitHub/GitLab PRs for accurate merge status using GitHub CLI.
- Produces a prioritized, copy-paste cleanup command for both local and remote branch deletion.
- Zero config required; supports any Git repository and works without external API access.
- Always outputs a clear, structured Markdown report summarizing findings and cleanup recommendations.
